name: @meal/api
description: Java 25 + Spring Boot API. Maven does the work; these scripts are shortcuts, and db:local runs PostgreSQL without Docker.

scripts.start:dev: node scripts/mvn.mjs -q -DskipTests install -pl meal-rules -am && node scripts/mvn.mjs -pl meal-api spring-boot:run
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/mvn.mjs -q -DskipTests install -pl meal-rules -am && node scripts/mvn.mjs -q -pl meal-api spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.arguments=seed
scripts.dev: node scripts/mvn.mjs -q -DskipTests install -pl meal-rules -am && node scripts/mvn.mjs -pl meal-api spring-boot:run
